en.description: Turn contractor-supplied project names, unit names, and handover dates into three handover sign stills, then turn the rest of that project into a matching set. This project handover sign studio lays out each named completion board from the inscriptions you already have. Use it for project completion signs, handover sign boards, and matching completion-sign packs.
